Purpose

Builds and governs the third-party capacity that installs and distributes FWA: installer vendors, distributors and managed-service partners, on capacity, quality, commercial terms and compliance.

Job Description

• Source, onboard and certify installer and distribution partners to cover the Circle footprint for ODU installation and IDU delivery.
• Plan partner capacity: installers per district against forecast GA, with surge cover for launch and campaign peaks.
• Own the partner SLA framework covering acceptance time, install TAT, first-time-right, rework and escalation, with a monthly scorecard and real consequences.
• Negotiate and manage commercial terms: cost per install, cost per activation, distribution margin, and the penalty and bonus mechanics.
• Certify every partner technician on ODU mounting, alignment and acceptance testing before granting activation rights.
• Govern compliance: work permits, safety, conduct at the customer premise, device custody, and data handling.
• Run partner performance reviews, move volume to the partners who perform, and exit the ones who do not.
• Feed partner-side root causes back to Delivery, Network and HQ, whether the cause is a device defect, a coverage gap or process friction.

Requirements

• Seven to ten years in vendor or partner management, field service, or channel operations.
• Strong commercial negotiator with a real grip on SLA governance.
• Experience managing outsourced technician networks preferred.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
